key_insight: The paper proposes a Quantum Chip Paradigm Framework that shifts superconducting quantum chip design from experience-based practice to model-driven Q-EDA using physical, reusable engineering abstractions.
engineering_relevance: It matters because scaling quantum processors will require integrated workflows for layout, simulation, packaging, fabrication, and cryogenic measurement feedback, much like classical EDA transformed chip design.
method: Use PCell-based representations for Josephson junctions, resonators, couplers, readout elements, control lines, and packaging.
Adopt SPICE-Q, Quantum PDKs, and design-technology-measurement co-optimization.
Organize Q-EDA hierarchically from physical structures to qubit PCells, logical qubits, quantum arithmetic, IP, and Quantum SoC systems.
evidence_signal: The abstract is a conceptual framework paper and does not report new experimental results or quantitative benchmark data.
watch_item: A major implementation challenge is standardizing accurate device, process, and measurement models across fabrication and cryogenic test environments.
